rows.en: <operator(17040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>, is something the matter?
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>...There will be an encounter here. One that could move the world... I sense a great hope.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Huh? What does that mean?
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Tiffa<ce()> can foresee the future with her Newtype power.
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>Because of this power, <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()> is targeted by the <color(5)>New Federation<ce()>.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Captain <color(4)>Amuro<ce()>, do you sense it too?
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>No... I can't tell what she is sensing.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>An encounter that moves the world... That's kind of amazing.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Moving the world doesn't have to mean it's a good thing, does it?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>You have no sense of romance...
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>, are you all right?
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>I've managed to switch gears. I can't stay down in the dumps forever.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>Looking good. I'm glad you're thinking positive.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Everyone's calm even in a situation like this. When I think of that, being the only one panicking is uncool.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>That's a boy for you. You adapt fast.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>F-flatter me all you want, I still haven't decided to fight, you know!
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Light<ce()>, you've been in a staring contest with that monitor for a while. What's up?
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>I'm checking whether the enemies we registered last battle show up on radar.
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>Jamming works on the enemies here too, so I want to get the first move in.
<operator(10020,1)><speed(2)>That's <color(4)>Light<ce()> for you... so diligent.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Jamming? Shoot 'em down before it comes to that and you're done.
rows.notes: Capital 'Jamming' at sentence start used to avoid lowercase j.

rows.en: <operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>Lieutenant, battle is all about information. Pin down the enemy's moves and win. Zero losses is the best win, right?
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>I don't really get the hard stuff, but hey, I'm counting on you.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Garrod<ce()>... you look younger than me, so why are you fighting in a war?
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>To protect <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>Besides... for us, living itself is a battle.
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>Age has nothing to do with fighting. People fight because they have a reason.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>A reason, huh... Not that I have one.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>...No.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Huh? Me?
<operator(17070,1)>Yes. There is something waiting further along the path you walk...
rows.notes: Source row has no <speed(2)> tag; preserved.

rows.en: <operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Huh...? You mean something will happen if I fight?
<operator(17070,1)>That... is up to you.
rows.notes: Source row has no <speed(2)> tag; preserved.

rows.en: <operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>You two, are you fine with what we discussed earlier?
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>You mean being this ship's exclusive mobile suit riders?
<operator(17020,2)><speed(2)>As long as I get paid, that's fine by me.
<operator(17030,2)><speed(2)>I was getting tired of drifting around anyway.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>What... you guys are mercenaries?
<operator(17030,2)><speed(2)>We do more than what we're paid for, though.
<operator(17020,2)><speed(2)>With us around, you guys won't get a turn, you know?
<operator(10010,2)><speed(2)>That's OUR line!
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Garrod<ce()>, you're really fine with working for free?
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>I fight to protect <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>. I don't need any money.

uncertainties.issue: 'New Federation' follows glossary.json / encyclopedia_022 (provisional there); character_names_021 lists 'New UNE' as the Gundam X wiki form.
Added 'sir' to carry Barrel's polite register toward Amuro; remove if unwanted.
Tiffa's '...No.' contradicts Barrel's 'I have no reason'; next rows confirm she means him.
Jamil addresses Witz and Roybea ('you two') - inferred from who replies.
'mobile suit riders' follows the Gundam X term used in character_names_021 roles.

meaning_fixes.before: <operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>I've managed to switch gears. I can't stay down in the dumps forever, sir.
meaning_fixes.after: <operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>I've managed to switch gears. I can't stay down in the dumps forever.
meaning_fixes.reason: 'sir' is a military form of address the source does not contain; Barrel is an unwilling civilian who in this same chat insists he has not agreed to fight. Politeness is register only; nothing in the source to carry as an address.

checked_decisions: 0/23 'New Federation': glossary.json locks ACE3's 'New Federation' and explicitly warns against substituting the franchise name. Accepted.
1/104 Tiffa's '...No.' contradicting Barrel's 'I have no reason': rows 105-108 confirm. Accepted.
1/139 'You two' = Witz and Roybea: both reply, and Witz later contrasts them with Garrod. Accepted.
1/140 'mobile suit riders': matches role wording in character_names_021. Accepted.
Genders used (Tiffa her/she, 'boy' for Barrel from source 'otoko no ko') match glossary.
remaining_uncertainties: 1/20: removal of 'sir' is a register call; Barrel is polite (desu/masu) to Amuro and the English now carries that only through neutral wording.
